verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say you can "create your first agent with a single command," which implies a first-party scaffolding command. The pack never names a CLI, documents its commands, or shows AI-native CLI workflows, so support is a thin, indirect mention. Missing for 10: an explicitly named official CLI with documented commands (e.g., dev/build/deploy), evidence of AI-native or agent-driven CLI usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
